title: ONE STATUS LINE ON THE TITLE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. Once you had logged a raid, the line under the mode list (your name, raids logged, credits banked) repeated the active save just below it. It is folded away then; on a first run the line that says what to do is kept.
now: The title no longer repeats your save details twice.
